title: Edit Plugins
intro: WordPress’s Plugin File Editor edits plugin PHP files in the browser. Backdrop has no equivalent on purpose: module code lives on disk and is never written by the admin interface.
backdrop: Modules are directories under modules/ (contrib or custom), each with a .info file. They are installed from the admin UI (Plugins → Add Plugin, which downloads from backdropcms.org) or by copying files, and enabled on the Modules page; their settings are configuration, editable in the UI and exportable as JSON.
